ranking.reason: Guard 'used > 1' skips the coupon transition for used == 1, so states using exactly one coupon are never computed; should be 'used > 0'.
Base case sets start free (0) for every used >= 1; only one coupon can be spent at the start, so higher-used values may be inconsistent.
Coupon transition reads state used-1; combined with the wrong guard at line 90, single-coupon predecessor states are never populated.
